verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS Real-Time stages are a real-time media product, so a question about selective forwarding is fair to ask. The evidence covers sub-300ms latency, up to 12 hosts, and client- or server-side composition. It never describes an SFU or relay architecture, and nothing shows media being delivered only for the tracks each participant subscribes to.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to
